sources.title: Burkina Faso country information
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Russian MFA Consular Department country page expressly assigns Russian passport holders on short trips to the Burkina eVisa system.
sources.supportingExcerpt: с 1 января 2022 г. действует система получения электронных виз «evisa Burkina».

sources.title: Visa Burkina electronic visa procedure
sources.publisher: Ministry of Security / Directorate General of the National Police
sources.officialityEvidence: The live service identifies the Ministry of Security and National Police and describes electronic visa issuance after online information and payment.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les postulants peuvent obtenir leur visa par voie électronique.

sources.title: Comoros country information
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Russian MFA Consular Department page directly states the short-stay airport-issuance procedure for Russian ordinary passport holders.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Однократную краткосрочную (на 45 дней) визу можно получить непосредственно в аэропорту.

sources.title: Djibouti country information
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Russian MFA Consular Department page reproduces general foreigner eVisa guidance from 2021 but does not map Russian ordinary passports to eligibility.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Оформление въездной визы в общегражданский заграничный паспорт по прибытии ... не осуществляется.

sources.title: Central African Republic country information
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Russian MFA Consular Department page directly identifies Moscow's Central African Republic Embassy as the Russian visitor-visa issuance point.
sources.supportingExcerpt: необходима виза, получить которую можно в Посольстве ЦАР в Москве.

sources.title: Chad country information
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Russian MFA Consular Department page directly requires Russian citizens to obtain a Chad visa at a diplomatic mission or consulate.
sources.supportingExcerpt: гражданам России необходимо оформить визу в дипломатическом представительстве или консульском учреждении Республики.

sources.title: Republic of the Congo country information
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Russian MFA Consular Department page distinguishes diplomatic/service waivers and says the ordinary visa is a passport sticker from Congo's Moscow Embassy.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Виза оформляется в консульском отделе Посольства Республики Конго в России.

sources.title: Liberia country information
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Russian MFA Consular Department page directly identifies Liberia's German, French and Italian embassies as the Russian visitor-visa route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Виза российским гражданам оформляется в посольствах Либерии в Германии, Франции и Италии.

sources.title: Mali country information
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Russian MFA Consular Department page says Russian visitors must obtain a visa at Mali's Embassy and cannot obtain one at Bamako airport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Для въезда в страну необходима виза, получить которую можно в Посольстве Республики Мали.

sources.title: Niger country information
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Russian MFA Consular Department page identifies foreign Niger missions where Russian applicants can obtain a visa; it does not infer an online route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Можно получить визу в странах, где присутствует представительство Нигера.

sources.title: North Macedonia country information
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Russian MFA Consular Department page says North Macedonia ended the bilateral visa-free regime on 15 March 2022 and identifies foreign diplomatic missions for visas.
sources.supportingExcerpt: С 15 марта 2022 года безвизовый режим между нашими странами ... отменен.

sources.title: South Sudan country information
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Russian MFA Consular Department page describes advance embassy issuance but contains a 2017 exchange rate and predates South Sudan's current eVisa service.
sources.supportingExcerpt: визу ... необходимо получать заранее в Посольстве Южного Судана.

sources.title: Sudan country information
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Russian MFA Consular Department page says ordinary Russian passports need a visa and identifies Sudan's Russian Embassy as the usual issuer amid the current conflict.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Как правило, виза выдается на один или два месяца Посольством Судана в России.

policies.title: Russian ordinary passports: Burkina Faso electronic short-stay visa
policies.summary: Russia's current MFA guidance directly assigns Russian passport holders making short visits to Burkina Faso's official electronic-visa system.
conditions: Use the official electronic route for transit or short stays of up to 90 days; passport validity must be at least three months.
Work, residence, special passports, travel registration, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Visa Burkina
steps: Pay online and retain the electronically issued visa for travel.

policies.title: Russian ordinary passports: Comoros short-stay arrival visa
policies.summary: Russia's current MFA guidance says a Russian ordinary passport holder may obtain a single 45-day short-stay visa directly at the airport.
conditions: Present a passport, return air ticket, hotel reservation and the stated EUR 60 fee at the airport.
This is a single short-stay visa of up to 45 days; residence, special passports and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Russian ordinary passports: named advance visitor-visa routes
policies.summary: Current Russian MFA country guidance identifies ordinary Russian visitor visas issued by the named diplomatic missions for these destinations.
conditions: Central African Republic: obtain the visa at its Embassy in Moscow; Chad: obtain it at a Chadian diplomatic mission or consulate.
Republic of the Congo: apply at its Moscow Embassy; Liberia: use Liberia's embassies in Germany, France or Italy; Mali: use Mali's Embassy.
Niger: apply where Niger has a diplomatic mission; North Macedonia: use its diplomatic missions abroad, unless separately qualifying through a residence permit or multi-entry Schengen C visa.
Sudan: ordinary passports normally receive a one- or two-month visa from Sudan's Embassy in Russia.
The listed routes are for ordinary short visits only; work, residence, diplomatic/service passports, route-specific exceptions and final admission remain separate.
